image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a baby lying on its back on a textured beige carpet. The baby is wearing an orange long-sleeved onesie and a white diaper. A second, unused white diaper lies in the foreground, slightly out of focus. The baby's face is partially visible, looking towards the camera with a calm expression. The lighting is soft and indoor.
